name: user-agent-tools
short_description: Python library for generating and interpreting user agent strings from real-world browser data.
long_description: User Agent Tools is a lightweight Python utility that provides functionality for working with user agent strings. It enables developers to generate random user agents from a curated dataset of real-world user agents ranked by prevalence, filter them by browser type and operating system, and parse user agent strings to extract detailed information about operating systems, browsers, browser versions, and device platforms. The library includes comprehensive support for multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, Kindle) and browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera, Edge, Internet Explorer), making it useful for web scraping, testing, security applications, and browser compatibility simulation.

modules.description: Core module providing the UA class for generating random user agents, interpreting user agent strings, and managing user agent datasets with filtering and probability-based selection.
Package initialization that exports the UA class and defines version and program metadata.
Comprehensive unit tests covering user agent generation with filters, interpretation of various browser and OS combinations, and edge case validation.
Package configuration and distribution metadata for PyPI deployment and dependency specification.
Build automation script that formats code with black, runs flake8 linting, executes tests, and updates .gitignore.
Dataset of real-world user agent strings with associated probability rankings sourced from willshouse.com.
User-facing documentation with installation instructions, feature overview, and usage examples.
